rule: Every input row must trace to an official NFL or club page read in this session, and the pack must be non-commercial and informational only.
how_it_removes_luck: Does not remove luck; it prevents a result that cannot be lawfully reproduced from ever reaching the board.

rule: A strategy may not be graded against any price this repository did not obtain under licence. Reference prices stay blank.
how_it_removes_luck: Prevents a fabricated benchmark from manufacturing apparent skill.

rule: At least 200 graded selections per strategy family before any performance statistic is published.
how_it_removes_luck: Small samples are dominated by variance; the floor stops a short lucky run from qualifying.

rule: Parameters are fitted on seasons strictly before the test season; no random k-fold and no same-season fitting.
how_it_removes_luck: Removes in-sample optimism, the most common way luck is mistaken for skill.

rule: Hypothesis, signal rule, stop rule and parameter values are recorded before any selection is graded.
how_it_removes_luck: Removes post-hoc rule-shopping, which turns noise into apparent signal.

rule: Holm-Bonferroni correction across the whole strategy family at family-wise alpha = 0.05.
how_it_removes_luck: Ten strategies tested at 5% produce a false positive far more often than 5% of the time.

rule: Forecasts are scored with Brier score and log loss against a stated baseline, and reliability is reported.
how_it_removes_luck: A strategy can win bets and still be badly calibrated; proper scores expose that.

rule: Report the difference between the price taken and the closing price.
how_it_removes_luck: Beating the close is the standard test that separates information from variance.

rule: Every parlay and same-game combo price is built from a measured dependence. Independence is never an input.
how_it_removes_luck: Assuming independence in a correlated combo misprices the joint event in one direction only.
blocking_missing_input: Paired licensed residual history for each leg pair.

rule: The lower bound of a slate-clustered 95% confidence interval on the skill statistic must exceed zero.
how_it_removes_luck: A point estimate above zero is not evidence; the interval must exclude zero after clustering by slate.

rule: A market family tied to officiating or injuries, or knowable in advance or manipulable by one person, is permanently ineligible.
how_it_removes_luck: Keeps the catalog inside the league's own integrity policy rather than testing the boundary.

rule: One deterministic command rebuilds every table; seeds are fixed; all inputs are versioned in git.
how_it_removes_luck: A result that cannot be recomputed cannot be audited, so it cannot count as evidence.
